channel.title: CIS 220 - Platform Programming :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Potential new course to be developed. Initial offering would focus on programs written for the web browser. Serves as a vehicle for providing event-driven programming and operating systems coverage for progammer-specific needs. Serves as part of a three-course progression, CIS 120 → CIS 220 → CIS 320. May need to be merged with CIS 320 to minimize staffing requirements. Course Description Programming against an interactive computing platform’s execution and event model — how the platform schedules code, isolates security boundaries, and supports concurrent and asynchronous behavior. Sections focus on a specific platform (e.g. web, mobile, desktop); consult the section syllabus for the platform and tools used. (Proposed catalog description, per resources/reference/degree-maps/cs.md.)
